# cloptima_llm_prompt_version (Resource)

Creates an immutable prompt version within a prompt template and optionally activates it. Changing content or change_summary creates a new version. Versions are permanent history: destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state and does not deactivate the version.

~> **Importing:** Import with `<template_id>/<version_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloptima_llm_prompt_template" "support_template" {
  name        = "support-agent-template"
  description = "System and grounding prompts for support agent"
}

resource "cloptima_llm_prompt_version" "v1" {
  template_id    = cloptima_llm_prompt_template.support_template.id
  change_summary = "Initial production release with polite tone and refund guardrails"
  active         = true

  content = "You are an empathetic, concise support assistant. Assist the customer with their order."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Prompt content, including any template variables (e.g. {{query}}).
- `template_id` (String) ID of the prompt template this version belongs to.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether Terraform activates this version when it is created, or when this value changes from false to true. Activating another version later supersedes this one without a plan change; use status for the version's current state. Defaults to true. If activation is blocked, for example by a pending release gate, the version is kept as a draft and the next apply retries activation.
- `change_summary` (String) Summary of what changed in this version.

### Read-Only

- `content_hash` (String) Hash of the prompt content.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Prompt version ID.
- `parent_version_id` (String) ID of the version this one was derived from, if any.
- `status` (String) Version status: draft, active, archived, or rolled_back.
- `version_number` (Number) Sequential version number within the template.
